title: Message template
description: A subject, a plain message for notifications and SMS, and an optional HTML message for email. {{ expression }} placeholders are filled from the record, e.g. {{ record.donorName }}.

subject.description: Email subject and notification title; may use {{ placeholders }}

body.description: Plain message for in-app notifications and SMS, and the plain-text part of an email. May use {{ placeholders }}

html.description: HTML for the email, or the page of a document template. {{ placeholders }} are filled in and escaped. Leave this empty to send the plain message as the email.

kind.description: A message for email and notifications, or a document printed as a PDF. Default message

whatsapp.description: An approved WhatsApp Business template sent instead of the body on the WhatsApp channel

name.description: Template name as approved in WhatsApp Business

language.description: Template language code, for example en or hi; default en

parameters.description: Values for the template's numbered placeholders, as expressions
